name: 生徒の声
text:
ショコラティエ来日、先着50名に限定チョコ……
いやこれ絶対行く……！
trans:
Did you hear? The chocolatier will soon be holding a
sale of their limited chocolates to the first 50
customers... We definitely need to go get some......!

name: 生徒の声
text:
でしょー！
じゃ、土曜は朝イチでチョコレートフェアね
trans:
Totally! Let's meet up first thing on Saturday
morning at the Chocolate Fair!

name: 生徒の声
text:
オッケー！　ここでいろいろ済ませるわ
自分用と友達にシェアする用と──……
trans:
Okay! I'll also finish up the rest of my prep there, I
suppose. My portions, and some to share with
friends, and hmm──......

name: 生徒の声
trans:
......Now, now. Is there someone else you need to buy
for?

name: 生徒の声
text:
え！？
……やー、あんまり考えてないかなあ……
trans:
Huh!? ......N-No way, I'm not thought much about
that......

name: 生徒の声
text:
そういう相手にさあ、
気合いが入ったチョコって渡せなくない？　逆に
trans:
Though on the contrary, when gifting chocolate to
someone like that, won't it becomes hard when so
much effort is put into it?

name: 生徒の声
trans: Yeah, I hear you... It's so hard...
